title: SWE-smith: Scaling Data for Software Engineering Agents
authors_zh: John Yang, Kilian Lieret, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kabir Khandpur, Yanzhe Zhang, Binyuan Hui, Ofir Press, Ludwig Schmidt, Diyi Yang
paper_type_zh: 软件工程环境与智能体训练数据构造管线
best_for_zh: 构建可执行 SWE-agent 任务、轨迹与训练环境的研究者
one_line: SWE-smith builds 50,137 executable Python repair tasks from test-breaking synthetic diffs and distills 5,016 successful SWE-agent episodes selected from 17,906 attempts.
SWE-smith 把 Python 仓库变成 Docker 化执行环境，并合成 5 万多条破坏测试的修复任务、轨迹和一个训练后的 SWE 智能体。
why: It makes the environment, task-construction contract, executable feedback, and trajectory-selection boundary inspectable for the data-construction and open-release track.
inclusion_reason: An open environment-first recipe for scaling executable software-engineering task construction and successful agent-trajectory distillation, with released code, task rows, environments, trajectories, and models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Repository-level software-engineering agents need more than issue text and a reference edit. Useful post-training examples require an executable repository state, tests that distinguish broken from repaired behavior, an agent interaction trace, and enough provenance to replay the outcome. Earlier SWE-style collections usually identified historical issues first and then built an environment for each task. That makes environment construction a repeated bottleneck and limits the number of tasks that can be harvested from one repository.

SWE-smith changes the unit of construction. It first makes one repository commit executable, then produces hundreds or thousands of synthetic repair tasks inside that shared environment. The paper applies this process to 128 Python repositories and reports 50,137 retained tasks. Each task begins with a diff that introduces a regression into code that was previously covered by passing tests; the repair issue is generated only after execution identifies which tests fail.

The Card therefore separates three objects that are easy to conflate: the synthetic task row, an agent attempt on that task, and the successful trajectory subset used for supervised fine-tuning. It also separates test-backed validity from realism. A patch that breaks and then can be repaired under the visible repository tests satisfies an executable contract, but this alone does not show that its issue text resembles real maintenance work, that it has no leakage, or that it is suitable as a held-out benchmark.

仓库级软件工程智能体所需的训练对象,不只是问题描述和参考修改。可用于后训练的样本还需要可执行的仓库状态、能够区分故障与修复的测试、智能体交互轨迹,以及足以重放结果的来源信息。较早的 SWE 风格数据通常先寻找历史问题,再为每个任务搭建环境;这会反复产生环境构建成本,也限制了单个仓库能够提供的任务数量。

SWE-smith 改变了构造单元:先让某个仓库提交可执行,再在共享环境中生成数百到数千个合成修复任务。论文将该流程用于 128 个 Python 仓库,报告保留 50,137 个任务。每个任务从一个会破坏原有正确行为的 diff 开始;执行确定哪些原本通过的测试变为失败后,流程才生成对应的修复问题描述。

因此,本 Card 严格区分三类对象:合成任务行、智能体对该任务的一次尝试,以及用于监督微调的成功轨迹子集。同时还区分"测试可验证"与"现实性"。某个修改能够在可见仓库测试下制造故障并被修复,说明它满足可执行契约,但并不能单独证明问题描述像真实维护工作、没有解法泄漏,或适合作为留出评测集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central design is environment first, tasks second. For an eligible repository, SWE-agent is given up to 100 steps to discover installation and test commands on the latest commit. A human then extracts and verifies those instructions, requires more than 80% of existing tests to pass, implements the test-output parser, and builds a Docker image. Tasks from the same repository and commit reuse that image instead of packaging one image per task.

Within the environment, SWE-smith creates bug-inducing diffs through five routes: LM Modify changes a function while trying to introduce an error; LM Rewrite reimplements a function from its header and docstring; procedural transformations mutate Python syntax trees; Patch Combination joins already generated edits from a file or module; and PR Mirror uses an LM to undo Python-file changes from a pull request against the current repository version. Candidates are applied and tested. Only those that make at least one previously passing test fail are retained, and runs over two minutes are discarded.

The failing tests are construction feedback, not a learned reward. For issue generation, an LM receives the bug diff, source for a sampled Fail-to-Pass test, and test output, then writes a GitHub-style problem statement with reproduction code. At repair time the executable grader checks the Fail-to-Pass and Pass-to-Pass groups. This gives task construction and trajectory filtering a common programmatic contract while leaving semantic realism as a separate audit question.

核心设计是"先环境、后任务"。对于符合条件的仓库,SWE-agent 最多用 100 步在最新提交上寻找安装和测试命令;人工随后提取并核验这些说明,要求现有测试通过率超过 80%,实现测试输出解析器,并构建 Docker 镜像。同一仓库与提交下的任务复用该镜像,而不是每个任务各自打包环境。

SWE-smith 在环境内通过五条路线生成会引入故障的 diff:LM Modify 尝试在修改函数时加入错误;LM Rewrite 根据函数头和文档字符串重新实现函数;程序化方法变换 Python 语法树;Patch Combination 组合同一文件或模块中已有的修改;PR Mirror 则让语言模型在当前仓库版本上撤销某个拉取请求对 Python 文件的改动。流程应用候选修改并运行测试,只保留至少让一个原本通过的测试失败的候选,并丢弃测试运行超过两分钟的候选。

失败测试是构造反馈,而不是学习得到的奖励。生成问题描述时,语言模型接收故障 diff、随机选取的一个 Fail-to-Pass 测试源码以及测试输出,再写成带复现代码的 GitHub 风格问题。修复阶段的可执行判定器检查 Fail-to-Pass 与 Pass-to-Pass 两组测试。这样,任务构造与轨迹筛选共享同一套程序化契约,而语义现实性仍需单独审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
Repository selection starts from the 5,000 most-downloaded PyPI packages as of 2024-11-18. The authors sort associated repositories by GitHub stars, remove repositories below 1,000 stars, and exclude all 12 SWE-bench test repositories. For each retained repository they use one commit and one verified image. The paper reports 125 unique repository-commit images occupying 290.54 GB for the 128-repository collection; immutable image digests are not published in the task rows.

Candidate generation produces .diff files. Execution validation compares tests before and after the bug patch and records target failures and preservation tests. The paper reports 50,137 accepted instances: 17,887 LM Modify, 4,173 LM Rewrite, 15,641 Procedural, 10,092 combined, and 2,344 PR Mirror. The main Hugging Face task schema at revision ea6d7173829c7ec8fa16c22055699ff2e9188091 contains instance_id, the bug-inducing patch, FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS, image_name, repo, and problem_statement. The patch field must not be interpreted as the agent's answer.

For trajectory collection, SWE-agent exposes shell execution, file viewing/editing, and submission actions. Expert runs are limited to 75 steps and USD 2.00. The paper reports 17,906 attempts over 8,686 unique tasks, producing a pool of 6,457 successful episodes. To reduce repeated easy examples, at most three successes per task are kept, yielding 5,016 fine-tuning rows. Teacher action records are converted from function-call form to the XML-style representation used by the student. Most rows use Claude 3.7 Sonnet; smaller comparison subsets use Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o.

Release history matters. The paper-time trajectory revision 470d6f28b7219c95f43c47843cc7c69f63e077f0 has 5,016 rows with messages and instance_id. A later revision, 08e109b4a59eaeebf80e4675cd125d42e7ac99a4, exposes tool, xml, and ticks splits with resolved, model, traj_id, and submitted patch fields and includes at least some unresolved rows. These split counts are alternative release views and must not be summed as independent trajectories; whether every failed paper attempt is retained remains unknown.

仓库选择从 2024-11-18 时 PyPI 下载量最高的 5,000 个包开始。作者按对应 GitHub 仓库的星标数排序,移除少于 1,000 星的仓库,并排除全部 12 个 SWE-bench 测试仓库。每个入选仓库只使用一个提交和一个经核验的镜像。论文报告,128 个仓库对应 125 个唯一"仓库—提交"镜像,总计占用 290.54 GB;任务行没有公布不可变镜像摘要。

候选生成阶段产出 .diff 文件。执行验证比较应用故障修改前后的测试,并记录目标失败测试和保持通过的测试。论文报告共接受 50,137 个实例:LM Modify 17,887 个、LM Rewrite 4,173 个、Procedural 15,641 个、组合修改 10,092 个、PR Mirror 2,344 个。Hugging Face 主任务数据在修订 ea6d7173829c7ec8fa16c22055699ff2e9188091 下包含 instance_id、引入故障的 patch、FAIL_TO_PASS、PASS_TO_PASS、image_name、repo 与 problem_statement。其中 patch 不能解释为智能体答案。

轨迹收集使用 SWE-agent,动作包括执行 shell、查看或编辑文件以及提交结果。专家运行上限为 75 步和 2 美元。论文报告在 8,686 个唯一任务上进行了 17,906 次尝试,得到 6,457 条成功轨迹。为降低简单任务重复出现造成的偏差,每个任务最多保留三条成功轨迹,最终得到 5,016 条微调数据。教师动作记录还会从函数调用形式转换为学生训练使用的 XML 风格表示。大多数轨迹来自 Claude 3.7 Sonnet,少量比较子集来自 Claude 3.5 Sonnet 和 GPT-4o。

发布历史不可忽略。论文时点的轨迹修订 470d6f28b7219c95f43c47843cc7c69f63e077f0 有 5,016 行,字段为 messages 和 instance_id。较晚的修订 08e109b4a59eaeebf80e4675cd125d42e7ac99a4 提供 tool、xml、ticks 分片,并增加 resolved、model、traj_id 与提交 patch 字段,其中至少包含部分未解决样本。这些分片计数是不同发布视图,不能相加为互相独立的轨迹;论文中的所有失败尝试是否都被保留,仍然未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence concerns construction scale and executable yield. Across all routes, 50.1% of generated candidates become retained tasks. Yield differs substantially by route: 96.9% for already validated patch combinations, 56.0% for LM Modify, 35.0% for LM Rewrite, 40.2% for procedural mutations, and 33.8% for PR Mirror. The dataset averages 381 tasks per repository and reaches 2,277 for pandas. These figures show how the environment-first design amortizes setup; they do not establish that all retained issues are equally realistic.

For the training study, the final 32B model is fine-tuned on 5,016 successful episodes drawn from 17,906 attempts. It reports 40.2% Pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified with one attempt and without a separate selector. Ablations show that more trajectories and more represented repositories tend to improve downstream resolution, while task difficulty ratings do not correlate cleanly with training usefulness. PR Mirror trajectories are strongest among the compared construction routes, LM Rewrite and procedural tasks remain competitive, and LM Modify is weaker.

The paper also provides negative evidence useful for audit. More than 25% of SWE-agent-LM-32B trajectories contain a repeated action sequence of length at least ten, versus under 4% for Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Repetition length ten is associated with an 89% failure probability, and 53% of student-model failures reach cost or step limits, often before modifying source code. A later scaffold intervention reduces repetition but slightly lowers resolution to 38.4%, suggesting repetition is often a symptom rather than the sole cause.

Benchmark improvement demonstrates that the selected trajectories can train a useful model under this scaffold. It is not a per-row quality certificate, does not validate the generated issue prose, and does not turn the visible-test tasks into an evaluation benchmark.

最直接的证据来自构造规模和可执行筛选产率。所有路线合计有 50.1% 的候选成为保留任务,但不同路线差异明显:已经基于有效修改组合的路线为 96.9%,LM Modify 为 56.0%,LM Rewrite 为 35.0%,程序化变换为 40.2%,PR Mirror 为 33.8%。数据集平均每个仓库有 381 个任务,pandas 最多达到 2,277 个。这些结果说明"环境优先"能够摊薄搭建成本,但不能证明所有保留问题具有相同的现实性。

在训练研究中,最终 32B 模型使用从 17,906 次尝试中筛出的 5,016 条成功轨迹微调,在单次尝试且没有独立选择器的条件下,SWE-bench Verified Pass@1 为 40.2%。消融实验显示,增加轨迹数量和覆盖仓库数量通常能提高下游解决率,而任务难度评分与训练有效性没有稳定对应关系。在比较的构造路线中,PR Mirror 轨迹效果最好,LM Rewrite 与程序化任务仍有竞争力,LM Modify 较弱。

论文还给出了适合审计的负面证据。超过 25% 的 SWE-agent-LM-32B 轨迹含有长度至少为 10 的重复动作序列,而 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 低于 4%;重复长度为 10 时,失败概率与 89% 相关。学生模型的失败中有 53% 达到成本或步数上限,且经常尚未修改源代码。后续脚手架干预减少了重复,却使解决率略降至 38.4%,说明重复常常是困难的症状,而非唯一原因。

基准提升证明所选轨迹能在该脚手架下训练出有用模型,但不是逐行质量证书,也不能验证生成的问题文本,更不能把测试可见的训练任务直接变成评测基准。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The main novelty is not a new test oracle. It is the inversion of the collection order: spend bounded human effort once on a repository-level environment, then reuse that environment to generate and verify many tasks. The paper estimates about seven minutes of manual work to extract installation and test instructions and about one minute to implement a test parser per repository, with roughly 20 total author-hours for the reported collection.

This design changes both storage and sampling. The paper reports 125 shared images using 290.54 GB, compared with an estimate of 50–150 TB if 50,000 instances each followed a per-task-image design. It also makes candidate generation modular: LM-based rewrites, deterministic syntax-tree mutations, combinations of validated patches, and pull-request mirroring all feed the same execution filter.

For reasoning-data curation, the important second contribution is the explicit bridge from task generation to full-episode data. The same executable task can yield multiple attempts; outcomes permit rejection sampling; a per-task cap controls oversampling of repeatedly solved tasks; and action-format conversion makes teacher episodes compatible with the student scaffold. The release therefore connects source task, environment, feedback contract, episode, and training selection more directly than a collection of issue-and-patch pairs.

The novelty has a boundary: the verifier is still the repository's existing test suite, issue descriptions are generated from privileged construction evidence, and the successful training subset removes most information about why attempts failed.

主要创新不是新的测试判定器,而是颠倒数据收集顺序:先在仓库级环境上投入一次有限人工成本,再复用该环境生成并验证大量任务。论文估计,每个仓库人工提取安装与测试说明约需 7 分钟,实现测试解析器约需 1 分钟;整个报告数据集约使用一位作者 20 小时的人工劳动。

该设计同时改变了存储方式和采样方式。论文报告 125 个共享镜像共占 290.54 GB;若 50,000 个实例都采用"每任务一个镜像"的设计,估算需要 50–150 TB。候选生成也因此模块化:语言模型改写、确定性的语法树变换、有效修改组合以及拉取请求镜像,都进入同一执行筛选器。

对于推理数据整理,第二项关键贡献是把任务生成明确连接到完整交互轨迹。同一可执行任务可以产生多次尝试;执行结果支持拒绝采样;每任务上限可以控制反复被解决任务的过度采样;动作格式转换使教师轨迹适配学生脚手架。因此,该发布比单纯的问题—补丁对更直接地连接了来源任务、环境、反馈契约、交互轨迹与训练筛选。

创新也有边界:判定器仍是仓库原有测试套件,问题描述根据构造阶段的特权证据生成,而成功训练子集删除了大部分关于尝试为何失败的信息。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
SWE-smith as presented is not a hidden-test benchmark. The target tests remain in the repository, and issue generation is conditioned on a bug diff, a failing test, and execution output. The paper explicitly notes that it does not check generated issues for ambiguity, underspecification, or solution leakage. A task may therefore be executable yet unlike a real issue, overly revealing, or solvable by exploiting visible tests.

The verifier inherits test-suite blind spots. Requiring one previously passing test to fail proves only that the injected edit changes tested behavior. It does not prove the synthetic bug is meaningful, that Pass-to-Pass coverage captures every regression, or that the generated issue faithfully describes the failure. Candidate yield is lower in repositories with weaker coverage. Timeouts can also mix infrastructure cost with candidate invalidity.

Reproduction is not fully self-contained at the row level. Task rows identify an image name but not an immutable digest, and the full result depends on repository commit, image availability, installation and test instructions, output parser, SWE-agent version, agent configuration, teacher API behavior, and decoding settings. The original task release, later 59,136-row metadata, language-specific successors, the 5,016-row paper trajectory snapshot, and later 24K–26K release views must not be treated as one fixed dataset.

Licensing also remains layered. The toolkit and dataset cards state MIT, but each source repository, dependency, test, pull request, and generated issue has its own provenance. Excluding the 12 SWE-bench test repositories reduces direct task overlap with that benchmark, but broader contamination through model pretraining, shared code, issue text, or repositories is unknown. Finally, the 40.2% benchmark result is aggregate downstream evidence, not proof of validity for every task or trajectory.

论文所呈现的 SWE-smith 不是隐藏测试基准。目标测试仍留在仓库中,而问题生成会使用故障 diff、失败测试和执行输出。论文明确说明,没有检查生成问题是否歧义、描述不足或泄漏解法。因此,一个任务可能可以执行,却不像真实问题、暴露过多信息,或能够通过利用可见测试来解决。

判定器会继承测试套件的盲区。要求至少一个原本通过的测试变为失败,只能证明注入修改改变了被测试覆盖的行为;它不能证明合成故障有实际意义、Pass-to-Pass 覆盖了所有回归,或生成问题准确描述了故障。测试覆盖较弱的仓库候选产率也更低,超时还可能把基础设施成本与候选无效混在一起。

单条数据并不足以独立重现结果。任务行只给出镜像名称,没有不可变摘要;完整结果还依赖仓库提交、镜像可用性、安装与测试说明、输出解析器、SWE-agent 版本、智能体配置、教师 API 行为和解码设置。原始任务发布、后来显示 59,136 行的元数据、按语言维护的后续版本、论文时点 5,016 行轨迹快照,以及后来 24K–26K 规模的发布视图,不能视为同一个固定数据集。

许可同样具有多层来源。工具包和数据卡声明 MIT,但每个源仓库、依赖、测试、拉取请求和生成问题都有各自的来源。排除 12 个 SWE-bench 测试仓库减少了与该基准的直接任务重叠,但模型预训练、共享代码、问题文本或仓库层面的更广泛污染仍未知。最后,40.2% 的基准结果只是聚合的下游证据,不是每个任务或轨迹都有效的证明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction and open-release track, SWE-smith is most useful as a worked recipe for turning one verified repository environment into many executable training tasks. Curators can compare its five candidate routes by cost, yield, edit scope, affected tests, and downstream trajectory utility rather than treating all synthetic tasks as interchangeable. The task table is also useful for studying repository-level sampling, test-coverage bias, issue-generation leakage, and environment amortization.

The 5,016-row paper-time trajectory snapshot supports supervised agent training and teacher distillation when paired with the matching SWE-agent action representation. The larger later trajectory revision can support failure analysis because it includes outcome, model, trajectory ID, and submitted patch fields and contains at least some unresolved rows. It should not be used as if all rows were the successful SFT set, and the three later split counts should not be added together without establishing their relationship.

A minimum reuse manifest should pin the task and trajectory commit hashes, Docker image digests, source commits, repository licenses, install/test/parser specifications, SWE-agent and harness revisions, action schema, teacher identity, limits, and decoding settings. It should also record whether the use case needs only successful demonstrations, a balanced success/failure corpus, or full attempt accounting. If replay cannot reproduce the stored resolved value, the outcome should be downgraded to unknown rather than copied as fresh verification.

The tasks are appropriate for post-training experiments, environment and scaffold research, verifier diagnostics, and synthetic-data audits. Without additional hidden tests and issue-quality review, they are not appropriate as an uncontaminated leaderboard benchmark.

在"数据构造与开放发布"赛道中,SWE-smith 最适合作为一套完整案例:如何把一个经核验的仓库环境扩展成大量可执行训练任务。整理者可以按成本、产率、修改范围、受影响测试和下游轨迹效用比较五种候选路线,而不是把所有合成任务视为同质对象。任务表还适合研究仓库级采样、测试覆盖偏差、问题生成泄漏和环境成本摊销。

论文时点的 5,016 行轨迹快照在匹配 SWE-agent 动作表示后,可用于智能体监督训练和教师蒸馏。更大的后续轨迹修订包含结果、模型、轨迹 ID 和提交补丁字段,并至少保留部分未解决样本,因此可用于失败分析。但不能把其中所有行都当作成功 SFT 子集,也不能在没有确认分片关系的情况下直接相加三个后续分片的行数。

最低限度的复用清单应固定任务和轨迹提交哈希、Docker 镜像摘要、源提交、仓库许可、安装/测试/解析器说明、SWE-agent 与执行框架修订、动作模式、教师身份、运行上限和解码设置。还应说明用途究竟只需成功示范、需要平衡的成功/失败语料,还是要求完整尝试账本。如果重放不能复现保存的 resolved 值,应把结果降为未知,而不是把旧标签当作新的验证。

这些任务适合后训练实验、环境与脚手架研究、判定器诊断和合成数据审计。若没有额外隐藏测试与问题质量审查,则不适合作为无污染排行榜基准。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read patch as the injected regression diff, not as the repair answer; pair it with FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS, the issue, and the named image.
  • Keep the paper snapshot separate from mutable releases: 50,137 task rows in the paper, 5,016 successful SFT rows at trajectory revision 470d6f..., and larger later trajectory views with explicit outcomes.
  • The replay-critical missing items are immutable image digests, exact source commits and parsers, harness and SWE-agent revisions, and a complete map from attempts to released rows.
  • The most important audit distinction is executable validity versus semantic quality: tests support the former, while issue realism, leakage, licensing, and broader contamination remain separate checks.

• 将 patch 读取为注入回归的 diff,而不是修复答案;应与 FAIL_TO_PASS、PASS_TO_PASS、问题描述和指定镜像一起理解。
  • 区分论文快照和可变发布:论文有 50,137 个任务;轨迹修订 470d6f... 有 5,016 条成功 SFT 数据;更晚的大型轨迹视图才带显式结果字段。
  • 重放最关键的缺失项包括不可变镜像摘要、准确源提交与解析器、执行框架和 SWE-agent 修订,以及从全部尝试到已发布行的完整映射。
  • 最重要的审计边界是"可执行有效性"与"语义质量":测试支持前者,而问题现实性、泄漏、许可和更广泛污染仍需分别检查。

value.html: Synthetic repair issues built from bug-inducing diffs, one sampled Fail-to-Pass test source, and execution output in 128 Python repositories; the paper excludes the 12 SWE-bench test repositories.
Task rows contain instance_id, bug-inducing patch, FAIL_TO_PASS, PASS_TO_PASS, image_name, repo, and problem_statement; trajectory rows contain an agent message sequence linked by instance_id.
SWE-agent runs with Claude 3.7 Sonnet for most trajectories and smaller Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o comparison subsets.

items: resolved, model, traj_id, and submitted patch in the later trajectory revision

value.html: A Docker image shared by tasks from one repository and pinned commit, with repository-specific install, test, and output-parsing instructions.
Candidate bugs are retained only when they make at least one previously passing test fail; repair outcomes are graded by Fail-to-Pass and Pass-to-Pass tests in the executable environment.
A submitted repair is resolved when all target failing tests recover and the designated preservation tests continue to pass; timeouts and harness errors are not successful resolutions.
Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct-7B and Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct-32B; the main released model uses 32B.
Claude 3.7 Sonnet (claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219) for most trajectories, with smaller Claude 3.5 Sonnet and GPT-4o comparison subsets.
LM Modify, LM Rewrite, procedural AST transformations, patch combination, and PR Mirror create bug candidates; an LM writes issue text from the diff, a sampled failing test, and test output.

Select eligible Python repositories, build one reusable environment per repository commit, synthesize diff candidates, execute tests, retain test-breaking candidates, generate issue text, run SWE-agent teachers, and keep resolved episodes for rejection-sampling fine-tuning.

Require a repository image with more than 80% of existing tests passing; discard bug candidates that break no previously passing test or whose test run exceeds two minutes; cap successful training trajectories at three per task.
Expert runs use at most 75 steps and a USD 2 cost limit; the paper reports 17,906 attempts over 8,686 unique tasks and a 6,457-success pool before capping to 5,016 training episodes.
SWE-agent with bash, str_replace_editor, and submit actions; teacher function-call records are converted to the XML-style action representation used for student fine-tuning.
50,137 synthetic Python repair tasks from 128 real repositories, spanning LM-generated mutations, procedural mutations, combined patches, and mirrored pull-request edits.

The paper-time task release has 50,137 rows; the paper-time trajectory revision 470d6f28b7219c95f43c47843cc7c69f63e077f0 has 5,016 training rows. Later mutable revisions have different schemas and counts and must be pinned.
The 12 SWE-bench test repositories were excluded from task construction, but no broader code, issue-text, model-pretraining, or benchmark contamination audit is reported.

items: Existing tests are visible in the task repository, so SWE-smith as presented is training data rather than a hidden-test evaluation set.
Passing the repository tests establishes an executable contract but does not prove that a synthetic issue is realistic, unambiguous, or free of solution leakage.
Shared images reduce storage but replay still depends on image availability, repository state, parser behavior, harness versions, and exact agent configuration.

The paper-time successful SFT subset omits failed attempts; a later trajectory revision exposes resolved labels and includes at least some unresolved rows, but completeness of failed-attempt retention is unknown.
Current Hugging Face task metadata reports 59,136 examples while its prose still says 50,137, and later language-specific releases are outside the original Python paper snapshot.
SWE-bench Verified performance is evidence of downstream model utility, not proof that every task or trajectory is high quality.
